title: Coast Guard Cutter James launches unmanned aircraft system to support Hurricane Dorian response efforts
description:
Video footage was captured from an unmanned aircraft system launched from Coast Guard Cutter James deployed during Hurricane Dorian response efforts near Moore's Island on Abaco Islands in the Bahamas, Friday, Sept. 6, 2019.

Coast Guard Cutter James crewmembers worked with Bahamas Incident Command Air Cell and Government of the Bahamas to provide aerial support for hurricane relief efforts. 

This mission marked the first time that a UAS was utilized during Coast Guard hurricane response efforts, allowing manned air operations to focus on emergent search and rescue needs. U.S. Coast Guard video.
keywords: unmanned aircraft system, Dorian, Hurricane Dorian, hurricane efforts, Coast Guard, UAS
